script_text: Stop! Gemini, Mercury just went rogue in your sky and the whole chart feels electric. Your ruling planet Mercury is forming a combust conjunction with Uranus in your 5th House of Romance right now, sparking sudden ideas and restlessness you can't ignore. Meanwhile, Jupiter in Leo is sextiling your 10th House of Career, which is quietly opening a door at work you didn't see coming. Love-wise, if you're single, someone surprising could slide into your DMs by tonight; if taken, your partner may push you toward an impulsive decision — pause before you say yes. In your 2nd House, Venus in Aries is squaring your chart ruler, warning you against overspending on impulse purchases. On the bright side, an unexpected message could land in your lap from someone you haven't heard from in years. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
